violated_contract: An enrolled client-direct provider key must take effect without a relaunch and must never be governed by the managed-plan quota: the app's credential boundary for a send is the client-direct provider, not the managed shell the chat surface runs inside.
canonical_prevention: Respawn the agent runtime whenever the effective BYOK environment changes (the pi-mono extension registers client-direct providers per spawn), and admit sends through one quota policy that keys on the effective credential boundary so an active client-direct provider is exempt while server-routed BYOK keeps the backend verdict as the authority.
